request.prompt: Create exactly ONE faithful complete 2D game-asset sprite of the standard Remnant Nullifier from Mass Effect Andromeda, using the supplied BioWare finished textured three-view model sheet as the visual authority. Output ONLY the RIGHTMOST figure: the entire hovering front three-quarter view, preserving its camera angle and exact pose. Match the wide elevated horizontal upper pods, central recessed mechanical body, the two tall curved vertical fins with multiple thin white-blue luminous stripes, dark and steel-grey angular armor panels, two long articulated lateral support limbs ending in narrow mechanical tips, and the hanging segmented ribbon-like mechanical bundles with short pale luminous ends. Preserve the relative lengths, spacing, asymmetry and overlap of every visible component in the rightmost view. The two other figures are supporting geometry references only; do not mix their rear-facing details into the chosen front view. Reproduce the original weathered metallic material, fine panel seams, white/cyan light bands and restrained surface wear, without adding equipment, arms, weapons or new mechanical shapes. Detailed realistic neutral-lit game-asset cutout with crisp readable edges. Exactly one complete machine, one view, no turnaround sheet. Keep every fin tip, pod, lower articulated tip and hanging cable end inside the canvas. Subject occupies at most 82 percent of canvas height and width, with generous empty transparent padding around all extremities. Fully transparent background; no black backdrop, floor, reflection, shadow, glow halo, attack beam, shield, scenery, labels, text, logos, frame or duplicated machine.

notes: Three complete finished textured views inspected by root; rightmost front three-quarter view selected.
Identification cross-check against labeled gameplay capture documented separately; no inference from asset filename alone.
Only one hover posture; anchored, airborne movement and shield states remain unvalidated.
